snippet.title: #JellyBubble is a fast-paced multiplayer party game focused on light competition, chaotic fun.
snippet.description:
In this indie party game, you control adorable Jelly Bubble Beasts and battle for the highest score using soap items, color-switch mechanics, and interactive arenas.

🎮 Gameplay Overview

• Collect and throw up to 5 unique soaps with different effects
• Same colors attract, opposite colors repel
• Interactive platforms: glass tiles, rotating floors, spring jumps, and random effects
• Every match feels different, perfect for friends, streaming, and party play
• Local & Online Multiplayer – up to 6 players online, plus 2–4 local split-screen. Dorms or living rooms, jump in anytime!And There is More modes in development

🎉 Playtest Coming Soon
If you enjoy games like Fall Guys, Party Animals, or Overcooked,
join the Jelly Bubble Playtest and dive into bubbly multiplayer chaos!
